question: Estimate the annual e-commerce GMV from Tier-2 cities in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Online physical-goods e-commerce (Amazon/Flipkart/Meesho/Myntra/AJIO etc.); excluding food delivery, OTA, edtech? Yes — physical goods only.
Definition of Tier 2: cities with 1-10 lakh population? Use commonly accepted Tier 2 definition (~100 cities, ~200M population).
Include both metro-shipped orders to Tier-2 customers and Tier-2 origin sellers? Customer-side GMV (where buyer lives).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: Tier-2 population → online shoppers → orders/year → AOV.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Tier-2 city population in India: ~200M (including ~100 cities like Lucknow, Indore, Coimbatore, Vizag).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Online shoppers (placed at least 1 order/year): ~50% of internet users = ~75M.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~200M (including ~100 cities like Lucknow, Indore, Coimbatore, Vizag).
Tier-2 average ~12 orders/year (vs Tier 1 ~25; growing fast due to Meesho, COD, vernacular UI).
~₹650 (lower than Tier 1's ₹900 — more value/fashion/home, less premium electronics).

calculationFlow: Online shoppers (placed at least 1 order/year): ~50% of internet users = ~75M.
AOV in Tier 2: ~₹650 (lower than Tier 1's ₹900 — more value/fashion/home, less premium electronics).
